title: Sum of block frequencies
statement: Let $w$ and $s$ be natural numbers, and let $T$ be a subset of the $sw$ positions arranged as $s$ blocks of $w$ positions each. For each block, count the positions of $T$ in that block. The sum of these counts over all $s$ blocks equals the cardinality of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite subset of the $sw$ positions
